name: memory_view
description: Read one of your notes about the user (by name, from the memory index), or a shared note (shared:<id>), in full.

name.description: The note's name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. writing-style; or a shared note's shared:<id>

name: memory_search
description: Search your notes about the user, and the shared notes, by words in their name, description or text (and by meaning, when the agent has an embedding model).

name: memory_save
description: Create a note about the user, or replace a whole note (same name). Keep it short; for a profile, preference or feedback note, add **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines. On a shared:<id>, or with scope workspace or node, it proposes the change to the people who edit shared memory.

name.description: The note's name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. writing-style; or a shared note's shared:<id>

description.description: One line saying what the note is about; it goes in the index

type.description: profile, preference, project, reference or feedback

scope.description: personal (default): your notes about the user. workspace or node (the user's current node): propose a new shared note

name: memory_edit
description: Change part of a note: replaces old_text, which must appear exactly once in it, with new_text.

name.description: The note's name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. writing-style; or a shared note's shared:<id>

old_text.description: Text in the note, copied exactly

name: memory_delete
description: Delete a note that is wrong or no longer useful (on a shared:<id>, propose deleting it).

name.description: The note's name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. writing-style; or a shared note's shared:<id>

name: chats_search
description: Search the user's past chats with you by words in what was said, to pick up earlier work or something they told you before. Returns chats (id, name, when) with matching lines; chats_read reads one.

name: chats_read
description: Read one of the user's past chats (an id from chats_search): what the user and you said, in order. Long chats come in parts: pass the offset it gives to read on.

offset.description: Characters to skip (from the previous part)
